name: QANX Bridge
rootCause: On May 18, QANX Bridge was attacked between 15:01:40 and 18:20:25 UTC. Developers can withdraw 100,450,000 QANX from QANX Bridge and sell it on Uniswap for 325 ETH, then transfer it to Tornado Cash. By May 26, the hackers had sold all the stolen QANX tokens.

descriptions.text: On May 18, QANX Bridge was attacked between 15:01:40 and 18:20:25 UTC. Developers can withdraw 100,450,000 QANX from QANX Bridge and sell it on Uniswap for 325 ETH, then transfer it to Tornado Cash. By May 26, the hackers had sold all the stolen QANX tokens.

QANX Bridge suffered a private key compromise on Ethereum Mainnet on May 18, 2022, resulting in approximately $707,000 drained from the protocol. No primary technical disclosure, transaction hashes, or vulnerable code have been published. The bridge’s controlling private key for Ethereum was compromised, allowing an attacker to drain $707,000 in assets via unauthorized transactions.
